summary: Meta released xformers v0.0.35, adding free-threading Python support and pre-built PyTorch 2.10.0 wheels while dropping bundled Flash-Attention 3 binaries in favor of PyTorch-provided wheels.

practices.reason: Teams depending on xformers' bundled Flash-Attention 3 wheels must now source that dependency from PyTorch's own indices instead.
practices.quote: Stopped bundling pre-built versions of Flash-Attention 3, and instead started relying on the wheels provided by the PyTorch indices.
